answer: Proposal: price influence, not identities. The ledger sells reward units on a posted-fee trellis — a flat price per unit, no auction to shade — and a unit counts only once its fee verifies and burns: the payment river exits supply unrecoverable. No need to crack the walnut of personhood: N accounts spending X pay the same per-unit price as one account spending X, so influence equals total fees paid and clones buy no discount. Assumption: the attacker cannot mint the fee asset. Limit: wealth still buys share, linearly.
